peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.statement: Price position — In line with comparable condos: 6.9% below its local comparables; 34 of 102 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Below peers (8.3): 2.9 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 9 of 108 similar developments with a figure. Context, not scored: resales in 83.3% of months (24 months).

rentalYield.caption: Gross yield = 12 x typical rent / typical resale price for the same size band. Before maintenance, property tax, vacancy and agent fees. Not a return on your cash. Lease: 99 yrs from 2010.

rules.peers: same class, market segment and 100 sq ft size band; original lease 99 years or longer, including freehold and 999-year (short leases excluded)
rules.range: the range from combining the middle half of rents with the middle half of prices (12 x lower-quartile rent / upper-quartile price to 12 x upper-quartile rent / lower-quartile price); not a confidence interval
rules.shortLease: Developments with leases under 99 years are excluded from standard long-lease peer groups.

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 1-bedroom: median $833,000 ($1,682 psf, 484–505 sq ft; 6 resales, Jun 2024–May 2026); 3 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,911 psf (range $1,626–2,129); 12% below; illustrative entry-price difference about $113,000 less. 2-bedroom: median $1,310,000 ($1,803 psf, 710–775 sq ft; 7 resales, May 2024–Apr 2026); 3 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,894 psf (range $1,715–2,192); 4.8% below; illustrative entry-price difference about $66,000 less. 3-bedroom: median $1,795,000 ($1,768 psf, 1,001–1,237 sq ft; 10 resales, Oct 2025–Sep 2026); 3 comparable developments within 5 km: median $1,838 psf (range $1,533–1,906); 3.8% below; illustrative entry-price difference about $71,000 less. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Lakeside MRT about 190 m, Chinese Garden MRT about 1,430 m; closer than 98 of 116 similar developments. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 4 within 1 km and 8 within 2 km; nearest Rulang Primary School about 470 m; more than 86 of 116 similar developments (the same as 18). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 4 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 840 m), more than 54 of 116 similar developments (the same as 26); nearest hawker centre Boon Lay Place Market And Food Village about 790 m; nearest park JLG: Lakeside Garden about 230 m. Straight-line distances.

nearestHawker.name: Boon Lay Place Market And Food Village

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 3 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (The Lakegarden Residences, 61 new sales, about 1,000 m; Sora, 41 new sales, about 1,140 m; Tengah Garden Residences, 863 new sales, about 1,830 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 17 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 965 new sales and 269 resales (1,234 purchases); new sales were 78.2% of these purchases. Subsales (0) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: Within 2 km: Lucerne Grand (launch, under construction), about 110 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Quiet area: local resales are among the lowest 30% of similar developments, so little nearby competition reflects a thin market, not an advantage. 269 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 25 of 116 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 269 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 263 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (+2.3%). Planning-area private resales −1.6%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
